api/BOOSEapp.html.title: Namespace BOOSEapp | docs
api/BOOSEapp.html.summary: Namespace BOOSEapp Classes AdditionalFeatures Provides additional BOOSE features such as random values, user input, and named colours. AppCanvas Custom canvas implementation used by the BOOSE interpreter. Responsible for drawing shapes and managing the drawing cursor. AppCommandFactory Custom command factory used to create BOOSE commands. It extends the default command factory and returns application-specific command implementations. ApplicationConfiguration Bootstrap the application configuration. Array Array interpreter extension for BOOSE, adding support for array variables. Supports int variables, real variables, int arrays, real arrays, together with poke, peek and simple write commands. Circle BOOSE command that draws a circle on the canvas. Clear Clears the drawing canvas. Form1 Main user interface for the BOOSE interpreter. Allows the user to input BOOSE programs, execute them, and display graphical output on the canvas. If Handles IF, ELSE and END IF logic in BOOSE programs. Int Simple interpreter extension that adds support for integer variables (int). Allows declaration, assignment and usage of variables in BOOSE commands. LogInDebug Singleton logger used to write debug information. Maths Provides simple mathematical expression evaluation (+, -, *, /) Method Simple interpreter that supports integer methods in BOOSE. Methods do not return values explicitly – instead, the result is stored in a variable with the same name as the method. MoveTo BOOSE command that moves the drawing cursor to a specified position on the canvas. Program Real Real variable support for BOOSE interpreter. Allows declaration, assignment and usage of variables in BOOSE commands. Rectangle BOOSE command that draws a rectangle on the canvas. Tri BOOSE command that draws a triangle on the canvas. Interfaces IInterpreter Common interface for classes that can run a BOOSE program.
